Tandem queue on a distance model — named places, no coordinates

The same walk as the moving-parts example, on a model that has no coordinates at all.

What to watch for

Its moves report NaN positions and the names of the places they run between. The layout supplies a position for each name — here from the model's own distance matrix, turned so the process reads left to right — and every move resolves against those. Spatial detail is a property of the drawing, not a requirement of the model.

Underneath

This is a real run of a real model, not a recording. The page fetched the trace (53 KB gzipped) and drew it through the same renderer the desktop animation application uses. Download it and open it there to lay it out yourself.

Read the model's source — the simulation is not modified to be animated; capture is a flag on a run.
